summary: modules can ship their own skills and agents; a name clash fails cleanly
appCreator: Nothing changes in an app today: no module ships an agent yet. A module's skills and agents now install with pack add, update with harness-sync and go with pack remove, also in an app that is still in discovery.

If a module's skill or agent has the same name as one the app wrote itself, pack add copies nothing and says which name to change; harness-sync and the health check say the same if the clash arrives with a later update.

branch.none: checked by hand at the #350 checkpoints

notVerified: No studio-scratch live check in a discovery-phase app (1.0 batch rule: checked by hand at the #350 checkpoints); install, update, remove and the three name clashes are covered by unit tests with a test module only.
The loader was not changed: a unit test shows it links a module's skill and agent from the app's copy, but no real Project thread was started to see them listed.
The routing test now loads module skills and has three human-docs prompts, but it was not run (it costs usage and needs the App-Studio Owner's yes).
